verdict.rationale: Honcho is a memory and state layer that agents call into. It is not an agent or host application that consumes external tools, so plugging MCP servers in as an MCP client is a category error for this product type. The evidence shows only the opposite role: Honcho ships its own MCP server (hosted at mcp.honcho.dev or run locally) for other AI tools to connect to. That server-side capability does not transfer to this client-side story.
